desc:
🦌 Your truck crashed in the wild. Hunt animals, sell your catch, fix the truck and drive home with your friends!

🐻 STORY MODE (1-4 players)
Hunt deer, boars and more, haul them to camp on your ATV and trailer, and sell them to hit the daily quota. Beat the boss of each land (Grizzly, Crocodile, Lion and Mammoth) to get the parts your truck needs. Every trip starts fresh!

🌲 OPEN HUNT (up to 12 players)
A huge open world with a lodge, outposts, roaming bosses and wild events like stampedes.

🎯 FEATURES
• 15+ guns, from shotguns to miniguns
• 5 classes: Tracker, Marksman, Hauler, Mechanic and Brawler
• Your own hunting dog sniffs out animals
• 4 lands: Forest, Tropics, Savannah and Antarctica
• Weapon crates and skins
• Easy, Normal and Hard

👥 Invite friends and hunt together!

📱 Play on PC, phone, tablet and console.
